title: El horario del fin de semana
description:
Ask your partner the following questions and write down 3 sentences  
summarizing your partner's routine (e.g., "Marcos sale de su casa a las  
diez...").

 * ¿A qué hora sales de tu casa los sábados? (What time do you leave your
   house on Saturdays?)
 * ¿Con quién sales los fines de semana? (Who do you go out with on
   weekends?)
 * ¿De dónde vienes antes de la escuela? (Where do you come from before
   school?) - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/course/8481408562/materials/discussion/view/8596224611
